title: AlphaGo Nature publication
summary: Nature published the AlphaGo paper on 27 January 2016, describing a computer Go system that combined policy and value neural networks with tree search and had defeated European Go champion Fan Hui by five games to zero.
significance: The paper documents AlphaGo as the first computer program to defeat a human professional player in the full-sized game of Go, while this record uses only the paper's publication date as its timeline date.

verification.note: Nature's article metadata gives 27 January 2016 as the publication date. Its abstract describes the policy/value network and tree-search approach, the 5-0 result against Fan Hui, and the first-professional-player milestone. This candidate does not treat the publication date as AlphaGo's development, completion, release, or match date.

sources.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search

candidateMeta.admissionReason: The 27 January 2016 publication milestone and the claims summarized here are directly supported by the Nature paper. Relationships remain empty until deliberate canonical admission and chronology review.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Review whether LINEAiGE should separately represent AlphaGo's October 2015 Fan Hui match and March 2016 Lee Sedol match as distinct milestones rather than collapsing those events into this publication record.
